annotations.title: SQL Query Plan EXPLAIN Optimizer & Bottleneck Diagnostics

description: Analyzes SQL EXPLAIN execution plans to detect sequential table scans, high-cost cartesian joins, and buffer memory bottlenecks. Use when diagnosing slow queries, optimizing database performance, or evaluating query cost; for getting index recommendations, use recommend_database_indexes instead. Stateless read-only edge call (max 32 KB, 60 RPM): accepts 'explain_plan_or_query' ('optimization_target' defaults to 'eliminate_seq_scans'), supports '?demo=true' or L402 (15 sats), and returns HTTP 400 if invalid.

explain_plan_or_query.description: Raw text or JSON output of EXPLAIN / EXPLAIN ANALYZE or the candidate SQL query.

optimization_target.description: Optimization goal: eliminate sequential scans, reduce memory buffers, or minimize join costs.

name: analyze_query_plan

outputSchema.description: Deterministic execution response schema for analyze_query_plan.

bottlenecks_detected.description: Identified query execution bottlenecks (e.g., Seq Scan on large table, Nested Loop join).

estimated_cost_reduction_pct.description: Estimated potential query cost reduction percentage with recommended optimizations.

recommended_rewrites.description: Specific SQL query rewrites and predicate adjustments to improve performance.

title: SQL Query Plan EXPLAIN Optimizer & Bottleneck Diagnostics
